notes:
Summary: enterprise code search platform focused on fast, precise developer workflows. Customer runs monorepo + package registries; heavy code + binary docs. Primary ask: large-scale embeddings + reranking with frequent re-index (daily deltas).

Key constraints / reqs: 
- Scale: ~250M embedding vectors today (mix of source files + compiled artifacts). Ingest pipeline: 10-30k docs/day, expect bursts during major releases (100k/day).
- Indexing cadence: full weekly rebuilds, daily incremental re-index, near-real-time deltas for PR merges (minutes).
- Latency targets: 1) k-NN lookup + coarse reranker: 50-150ms p50 end-to-end for developer query; 2) heavy reranker path (transformer-based re-rank on top-k): p95 < 700ms acceptable for deep searches.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (including ANN + reranker) <= $0.002 on average; very sensitive to tokenized reranker compute. Looking for batching/quantization guidance.
- Models: prefer open models for reranker (flan/tiny-{bert-like} for fast rerank, larger T5 variants for precision); want ability to fallback to smaller model under load.
- Storage & residency: cannot send certain codebases outside NA/EU. Must support KMS-managed keys and audit logs for all inference requests.
- Auth: enterprise SSO (SAML) tied to internal roles; RBAC enforced for index manipulation.

POC goals / success criteria: 
- Demonstrate sustained qps at target latency for 10k qps simulated developer traffic (burst to 50k qps) using dedicated pool.
- Measure end-to-end cost per query at 10k qps steady state, include reranker chargeback. Target <= $0.002/query.
- Validate SAML SSO + role-mapped RBAC with staging tenant.
- Re-index workflow: show daily delta indexing windows under 30 minutes for 2M changed vectors.
